items.name: Gale-Elder's Breath
items.lore: Won from the Gale-Elder when Fuamnach's Gale was ended. A little cold wind lives in it.

items.name: Cradle-Mother's Rattle
items.lore: Won from the Cradle-Mother when The Changeling's Swap was ended. It rattles when nobody shakes it.

items.name: Guardian Stone Ogham
items.lore: Won from the Guardian Stone when The Stones Rise was ended. The ogham reads 'keep'.
